name: 01_diary_and_meal
prompt: High fidelity premium Android FitnessApp UI mockup board, TWO large readable phone screens side by side, flat UI no device shells, Spanish. Continuous open charcoal #121416 backgrounds, champagne #D8C3A5, ivory #F4F0EA secondary #BCB7AE. SAME SMOKED LIQUID GLASS as selected fitness navigation: subtle translucent charcoal inputs and action pills with warm upper-rim reflections. NO enclosing giant cards, NO glossy borders around all sections, NO neon. Sections directly on background separated by typography and space. Only interactive controls have smoky glass. Cohesive accessible 48dp controls, generous but useful spacing, native Compose typography. Small board caption 'PROPUESTA · DATOS DE EJEMPLO'. All numbers are fictional UI examples, not nutrition guidance. No competitor logos, no fake verified badges. Nested Nutrition flow, back arrow instead of global bottom navigation. LEFT screen title 'Nutrición', subtitle 'Tu diario, con claridad'. Date selector 'Hoy, 26 nov' with arrows. Calorie ring small left and large readable '1.420 kcal registradas', 'Objetivo 2.200', '780 kcal hasta tu objetivo'. Three compact macro indicators directly on background with labels 'Proteínas 95 / 140 g', 'Carbohidratos 170 / 275 g', 'Grasas 40 / 60 g', champagne bars and distinct small line icons, no invented color ranking. Segmented tabs 'Diario' selected, 'Recetas', 'Tendencias'. Below four meal sections each simple icon, title, actual subtotal, plus action: 'Desayuno · 380 kcal', 'Comida · 620 kcal', 'Merienda · 220 kcal', 'Cena · 200 kcal'. Some expanded food rows with small circular neutral food thumbnail, title and quantity, no giant photos. Bottom floating '+ Registrar alimento' champagne button. RIGHT screen 'Comida', date 'Hoy · 14:00', subtotal '620 kcal' and compact macro summary. Three food rows with names and explicit quantities 'Arroz cocido · 150 g', 'Pechuga de pollo · 120 g', 'Aceite de oliva · 10 g', each overflow/edit. Small label 'Valores de ejemplo'. Actions '+ Añadir alimento', 'Copiar a otro día', 'Guardar como receta'. Open background all content, important values clear, no nutrition judgement or weightloss imagery.
